label: Lottie Accent
description: A professionally-animated vector accent from the curated Lottie set -- drop-in motion polish for a beat. Curated assets (use as data.asset): confetti, party-popper, check-mark, sparkles, fire, rocket, light-bulb, hundred, thumbs-up, heart, star, eyes, wave, clap, party-face, trophy, target, chart-up, bell, mind-blown. Position it small (10-25% of frame) over or beside the content it punctuates -- confetti on the success beat, check-mark as an item lands, rocket on launch copy. Like sticker-prop: seasoning, never the subject; 1-2 per scene max.

src.label: Alternative: /assets/ path to an uploaded Lottie .json

hold.label: Seconds visible before it exits (0/omit = stays to scene end)

loop.label: Loop while visible (default true; false = play once and freeze)

entrance.label: 'pop' (default) or 'none' when the asset animates its own entrance
